main_text.p: ὦ Δήμητερ. sic acuta, ἀνὴρ vir, δαὴρ levir, πατὴρ pater: ὦ ἄνερ, δαέρ, πάτερ. atqui ϊαχήρ.
ωσ3. vos. Disyllaba in ω, & adjectiva in ω, faciunt ενος, ut
main_text.l: ἀδὼ glandula, globosus sub cute tumor.
main_text.p: ὁ ἢ ἡ τέρων, (vel potius ὁ τέρων, ἡ τέρϝα) ὦ ὃ τέρεν, τέρενος: in vocativo ὦ τέρεν, tener, tenera, tenerum.

p.i: In ev vero neutra sunt omnia. sic adjectivum εἷς ἓν unus unum, ἑνὸς, (cujus foemininum est μία, una, μιᾶς) & composita μηδεὶς, οὐδεὶς, nullus: quae, quamvis primitivum singulare tantum sit, tamen pluraliter

page.notes: Greek and interlinear accents are uncertain in places; the Greek transcription is approximate. The 'ωσ' mark at the margin is a small note reference and was copied as printed.
